title: merremia bipinnatipartita

It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its reported health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of Merremia bipinnatipartita for medicinal use.
